title: Gears of War: E-Day is out now on Xbox and PC 💥
subject: gearsofwar
description:
Are you playing it on Game Pass or buying it? 👇

Gears of War: E-Day, the prequel from The Coalition and People Can Fly, launched October 6, 2026 on Xbox Series X|S and PC ($69.99, day one on Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass). Reviews sit in the high 80s on Metacritic, the series' best since Gears of War 3, and early access passed 20,000 concurrent players on Steam, about double Gears 5's peak.

Sources: Xbox Wire (Oct 1, 2026), Metacritic via ComicBook.com, Pure Xbox & GamesRadar+ (SteamDB data), Wikipedia
Game footage © Microsoft / Xbox Game Studios.
